Third-Party Attribution
========================

The MPK extraction logic in this project (tools/mgstool.py) is a faithful
reimplementation of the MPK ("Mages Package") container reader published by
Committee of Zero in their "SciAdv.Net" tools repository:

    Repository : https://github.com/CommitteeOfZero/SciAdv.Net
    Components : src/SciAdvNet.MagesVfs/MagesArchive.cs
                 src/SciAdvNet.MagesVfs/MpkFileEntry.cs
                 src/Tools/Ungelify/Program.cs (extract-all semantics)

Committee of Zero's tooling is used here under its published open-source
terms for the purposes of this non-commercial fan translation project
("Steins;Gate Persian Localization"), to extract text/script data the user
legally owns from the game archives.

The tests/fixtures/*.mpk files are the official test archives distributed in
the same upstream repository (tests/SciAdvNet.MagesVfs.Tests/Data/) and are
included solely to validate the local reimplementation.

STEINS;GATE is (c) MAGES. / Nitroplus. This project does not distribute any
original game files; it only processes a legally obtained copy.
